summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through QuadratureNexus + FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back to improve QuadratureNexus consensus scores (closed loop). Includes scaling an overnight autoresearch loop and applying proper experimental methodology.
summary.outcome: Implemented full EVO lifecycle tracking (E1-E6), fixed SurrealDB persistence (4 bugs), validated the Mycelium closed loop (E55-E62), discovered and fixed the critical SET-vs-additive bug in apply_mycelium_feedback (E57, committed with 11 regression tests), confirmed convergence formula consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n, integrated gymnasium sandboxed experiments (E52-E54), added retirement criterion to prevent running converged experiments, and fixed two pre-existing ARC bugs.

repo: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments on every call — any Mycelium calibration applied before it is silently wiped. Direct nexus.deliberate() calls preserve _score_adjustments.

Two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration (accumulates cross-cycle) vs _score_adjustments (reset per deliberation by run_llm_deliberation). E47 profile experiments must modify _mycelium_calibration, not _score_adjustments.
SurrealDB HTTP endpoint requires RETURN true; as probe (not SELECT 1; which returns 400). Auth: Basic root:root, headers surreal-ns/surreal-db required.
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary nested metadata subfields even as TYPE object. Workaround: pack variable data into result field (option<string>) as JSON string.
SurrealDB datetime fields require time::now() — string literals like '2026-05-01T21:00:00Z' are rejected.
QuadratureNexus voice baselines: Architect=0.70, Engineer=0.75, Ethicist=0.80, Resource=0.65. Resource only checked budget_available context (not description keywords) until this session.
ManifoldEnv: 19D obs (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space. Verifiable reward = 0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge. HIHO attractor at all-dims=0.5.
Gemini worktree at .gemini/worktrees/ is automatically cleaned up — code edited there is lost unless committed. ~3500 lines of E55-E62 experiment code was lost this way.
The overnight loop process used the Gemini worktree as CWD. uv traverses up to find pyproject.toml at git root, so conflicts there block all uv run commands.
asyncio.wait_for() with a negative timeout causes an instant TimeoutError with no delay — results in a tight spin loop that burns CPU without doing work.
UCB1 score conflates exploration policy (which chain to expand) with final answer selection (best result). Beam search best_chain must use actual score, not UCB1.
Pre-commit hooks include ruff format --check and ruff check — commits fail unless files are pre-formatted. Files must be staged after formatting, not before.
PatternExtractor DFS returns the first applicable transform in ops list order. Test data for invert was also solvable by flip_h (came earlier in list) causing false failures.
SurrealDB journey_point table is in cohezion/main namespace, not cohezion/cohezion. 225,550 records existed from earlier sessions.
Retirement criterion for autoresearch experiments: CV of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 (converged attractor) OR keep_frac == 0 AND n_runs >= min_runs (confirmed noise).

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback used SET semantics: self._score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment. Each cycle replaced prior calibration with a smaller value as the gap closed, causing consensus to decay on cycle 2. Fixed with additive accumulation: self._mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; self._score_adjustments[vt] = self._mycelium_calibration[vt]. Also added _mycelium_calibration: dict[VoiceType, float] = dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0) to __init__.

_evaluate_resource only checked context.get('budget_available') for score bonus. Extended to also give +0.10 for description keywords: cost, budget, efficient, resource, reduce. This makes it text-sensitive like the other voices.

Entire file was simulated — connect() set self.connected=True without any HTTP call. Rewritten with real httpx calls. Probe uses RETURN true; not SELECT 1;. Three CREATE journey_point bugs: string timestamps (need time::now()), missing metadata={}, SCHEMAFULL blocking metadata subfields (fixed by using result field as JSON string).

beam_search returned empty chain because UCB1 score for untried transforms (trials=0 → UCB1=∞) always ranked above confirmed-correct transforms. Fixed by tracking best_score/best_chain separately from UCB1-sorted exploration beam.

DFS returns first matching transform in ops list order. Test data [[0,1],[1,0]] → [[1,0],[0,1]] was solvable by both flip_h (earlier in list) and invert — test asserted invert but got flip_h. Fixed by using test data only solvable by inversion.

run_llm_deliberation (line ~307) does nexus._score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call. This overwrites any adjustments from apply_mycelium_feedback. E55-E62 experiments must call nexus.deliberate() directly to test Mycelium feedback effects. Also had accumulation inflation bug: (llm - base) compounded per-deliberation, reaching 1.0 by tick 3.

asyncio.wait_for(coro, timeout=min(3600, remaining_s - 10)) passed negative float when remaining_s < 10, causing instant TimeoutError spin loop. Fixed with max(30.0, remaining_s - 10) guard and early-exit check when remaining_s < 30.

New file with 11 regression tests for E57 fix. Key: synthesized skill helper must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' format (matching _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill output), not voice_scores=[...] format (which is ingest input). Tests cover: additive mechanism, no-decay on cycle 2, monotonic 5-cycle compounding, lr=2 threshold crossing, full pipeline lift.

workflow: Experiments require pre-specified hypothesis + null hypothesis + falsification criterion before running. E51 ran 4,786 iterations with cv=0.000 because nothing said 'stop'. A retirement criterion (20-line fix) prevents this.
timeit.default_timer() (alias for time.perf_counter) is correct for experiment wall-clock timing — monotonic, sub-microsecond, unaffected by NTP corrections.
Autoresearch loop self-pruning: keep_frac=0% after 40+ runs signals a noise experiment (E12/E46/E47); keep_frac=100% with CV=0 signals a converged attractor. Both should retire.
Vault persistence can be done via direct JSONL append to ~/vaults/cohezion-vault/memory/observations.jsonl when MCP tools are unavailable.
Format files with ruff format before git add to avoid ruff format --check hook rejections. Stage after formatting, not before.
When overnight loop processes accumulate, check /proc/<pid>/cwd to identify which script file they're actually using — may not be the main repo file.
The SurrealDB HTTP SQL endpoint accepts raw SurrealQL text with Content-Type: application/json. The Accept: application/json header is required for parsed responses.
For properly sandboxed experiments: use gymnasium ManifoldEnv/SwarmEnv with seed=42, fresh env.reset() per trial, env.close() after. Never share state between paired experimental conditions.
IEEE 754 edge case at exact threshold values: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 in floating point. Use result.approved (direct comparison in production code) as authoritative, not float mean recomputation.
When a PR is 210 commits behind target with lint-only changes, git merge-tree to test mergeability is safer than interactive rebase — avoids 'already applied' patch corruption.

friction: Gemini worktree cleaned up mid-session, destroying ~3500 lines of E55-E62 experiment code (retirement criterion, shared Mycelium registry, SurrealDB persistence) that had not been committed.
Multiple concurrent autoresearch/overnight-loop processes accumulated over the session, competing for the same log file, SurrealDB connections, and occasionally the same overnight_evo_loop.py file.

pre-commit hooks (ruff format --check, ruff check, Playwright) blocked commits repeatedly. Playwright hook had no files: filter and required a running Next.js server on every commit regardless of changed files.
pyproject.toml had unresolved merge conflicts (3 conflict blocks) that blocked all uv run commands until manually resolved.
Interactive git rebase started by a concurrent autoresearch process while editing files, requiring abort before work could continue.
Monitor output-rate limiting stopped monitors mid-session due to high-frequency experiment logging — required multiple restarts with tighter grep filters.
SurrealDB persistence was broken in 4 independent ways simultaneously: simulated client, bus.start() never called, worker.start() never called, SCHEMAFULL metadata field rejection.
Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure state mid-session (evaluation prompts return empty strings, arithmetic works). Required functional probe (2+2= test) to detect.
SCHEDULE label strings ('E55_mycelium') didn't match experiment= strings in log_result ('E55'), causing retirement criterion to never fire despite correct logic.
The running process loaded the Gemini worktree version of overnight_evo_loop.py but git status/edits targeted the main repo — edits had no effect on the running process until restart.
open_items: apply_mycelium_feedback has zero callers in src/ beyond its definition — the production feedback loop is not wired anywhere. CompoundExecutor._mycelium_registry never receives synthesized skills from autoresearch experiments.

SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records. The HTTP-direct write code was in the Gemini worktree that was cleaned up. E55-E62 experiments write ~41,983 results to autoresearch.jsonl but nothing to SurrealDB.

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (vacuum→coherent→dissolving between experiment phases). These are false alarms consuming healing budget on non-production data.

E46 JEPA learning is flat at ~0.97-1.00 final_loss across all runs — catastrophic forgetting erases each run. Requires distributional diversity (LLM mode) or persistent replay buffer with meaningful variance.
E64 (multi-cycle Mycelium compounding to threshold) was added to overnight_evo_loop.py SCHEDULE but not yet validated — first results not captured before session ended.
PRs 102-111 were all closed without merging. The reason was not investigated. PR #113 (autoresearch/pr-merge-20260502) contains all session work and remains open.
280 pre-existing test failures in the test suite (unrelated to session changes) — failure categories not fully diagnosed.

The autoresearch loop's current schedule (E12/E51/E46/E47/E50) runs old experiments. E55-E62 methodology (proper hypothesis/falsification) needs to be re-implemented in the main repo overnight_evo_loop.py.

Lemonade iGPU ROCm silent failure state not resolved. When it recovers, E63/E64 need re-validation with real Gemma-4 LLM scores (heuristic confirmations are deterministic, variance comes from LLM mode).

The 225,550 journey_point records in SurrealDB are all from earlier heuristic sessions. No LLM-mode journey data has been persisted — the gap between autoresearch.jsonl (complete) and SurrealDB (heuristic-only) is unresolved.
